name: NLAlib.chebyshevAmplifier_def
statement:
@[simp] theorem chebyshevAmplifier_def (α γ : ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    chebyshevAmplifier α γ q =
      C (1 / (Chebyshev.T ℝ q).eval (1 + γ)) * (Chebyshev.T ℝ q).comp (C (1 / α) * X)

name: NLAlib.chebyshevResidual_def
statement:
@[simp] theorem chebyshevResidual_def (a b : ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    chebyshevResidual a b q =
      C (1 / (Chebyshev.T ℝ q).eval ((b + a) / (b - a))) *
        (Chebyshev.T ℝ q).comp (C ((b + a) / (b - a)) - C (2 / (b - a)) * X)

name: NLAlib.chebyshevZero_injective
statement: theorem chebyshevZero_injective (q : ℕ) : Function.Injective (chebyshevZero q)

name: NLAlib.chebyshevZero_mem_Icc
statement: theorem chebyshevZero_mem_Icc (q : ℕ) (k : Fin q) : chebyshevZero q k ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1

name: NLAlib.degree_le_and_eval_zero_eq_one_iff
statement:
theorem degree_le_and_eval_zero_eq_one_iff {K : Type*} [Field K] {p : K[X]} {q : ℕ} :
    p.degree ≤ q ∧ p.eval 0 = 1 ↔ ∃ s : K[X], s.degree < q ∧ p = 1 - X * s

name: NLAlib.eval_chebyshevAmplifier
statement:
theorem eval_chebyshevAmplifier (α γ : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    (chebyshevAmplifier α γ q).eval x =
      (Chebyshev.T ℝ q).eval (x / α) / (Chebyshev.T ℝ q).eval (1 + γ)

name: NLAlib.eval_chebyshevResidual
statement:
theorem eval_chebyshevResidual (a b : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    (chebyshevResidual a b q).eval x =
      (Chebyshev.T ℝ q).eval ((b + a) / (b - a) - 2 / (b - a) * x) /
        (Chebyshev.T ℝ q).eval ((b + a) / (b - a))

name: NLAlib.exists_degree_lt_one_sub_eq_X_mul_of_eval_zero_eq_one
statement:
theorem exists_degree_lt_one_sub_eq_X_mul_of_eval_zero_eq_one {K : Type*} [Field K] {p : K[X]} {q : ℕ}
    (hp : p.degree ≤ q) (hp0 : p.eval 0 = 1) : ∃ s : K[X], s.degree < q ∧ 1 - p = X * s

name: NLAlib.abs_arccos_sub_chebyshevGridAngle_le
statement:
theorem abs_arccos_sub_chebyshevGridAngle_le (g : ℕ) (hg : 0 < g) (x : ℝ) :
    |Real.arccos x - chebyshevGridAngle g (chebyshevGridIndex g hg x)| ≤ Real.pi / (2 * g)

name: NLAlib.abs_eval_chebyshev_sub_grid_le
statement:
theorem abs_eval_chebyshev_sub_grid_le (g : ℕ) (hg : 0 < g) {x : ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) (j : ℕ) :
    |(T ℝ (j : ℤ)).eval x - (T ℝ (j : ℤ)).eval (chebyshevZero g (chebyshevGridIndex g hg x))| ≤
      j * Real.pi / (2 * g)

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.ofReal_re_quadForm
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.ofReal_re_quadForm {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (z : n → 𝕜) :
    ((RCLike.re (quadForm A z) : ℝ) : 𝕜) = quadForm A z

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.re_quadForm_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.re_quadForm_mem_Icc {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {a c : ℝ} (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc a c) (x : n → 𝕜) :
    RCLike.re (quadForm A x) ∈
      Set.Icc (a * RCLike.re (star x ⬝ᵥ x)) (c * RCLike.re (star x ⬝ᵥ x))

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.re_quadForm_smul_add_smul
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.re_quadForm_smul_add_smul {A : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (x y : n → 𝕜) (r s : ℝ) :
    RCLike.re (quadForm A ((r : 𝕜) • x + (s : 𝕜) • y)) =
      r ^ 2 * RCLike.re (quadForm A x) + 2 * r * s * RCLike.re (star x ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ y)) +
        s ^ 2 * RCLike.re (quadForm A y)

theorem quadForm_add (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (x y : n → 𝕜) :

theorem quadForm_eq_sum (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (z : n → 𝕜) :

theorem quadForm_smul (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (c : 𝕜) (z : n → 𝕜) :

name: NLAlib.quadForm_sq_eq_sum

    (A H : Matrix d d 𝕜) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hH : H.IsHermitian)
    (hAI : spectrum ℝ A ⊆ I) (hHI : spectrum ℝ H ⊆ I) :

    IsGreatest {r : ℝ | ∃ T : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ,
      T.PosDef ∧ r = (Matrix.trace (T * matrixLog M - T * matrixLog T + T)).re}

    IsGreatest {r : ℝ | ∃ T : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ,
      T.PosDef ∧ r = (Matrix.trace (T * H)).re + (Matrix.trace A).re -
        relativeEntropy T A}

    (φ : ι → κ → X → ℝ) (α β : ι → κ)

      if α i = β i then 1 else 0) :

    (hv2 : Integrable (fun x => v x ^ 2) μ)

    (hφφ : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ s, Integrable (fun x => φ i x * φ j x) μ)

NLAlib.QueryAlgorithm.transcript_truncate
statement:
@[simp]
theorem transcript_truncate (alg : QueryAlgorithm Q R q β) (f : Q → R) (i : ℕ) :

name: NLAlib.QueryAlgorithm.history_prependQuery
statement:
theorem history_prependQuery {q : ℕ} {β : Type*} (first : Q)
    (next : R → QueryAlgorithm Q R q β) (f : Q → R) (i : ℕ) :
    (prependQuery first next).history f (i + 1) =
      Fin.cons (f first) ((next (f first)).history f i)

name: NLAlib.QueryAlgorithm.history_withOutput
statement:
@[simp] theorem history_withOutput {q : ℕ} {α β : Type*} (alg : QueryAlgorithm Q R q α)
    (output : (Fin q → R) → β) (f : Q → R) (i : ℕ) :
    (alg.withOutput output).history f i = alg.history f i

name: NLAlib.QueryAlgorithm.queryAt_ofState
statement:
theorem queryAt_ofState (initial : S) (query : S → Q) (update : S → R → S)
    (q : ℕ) (f : Q → R) (i : ℕ) :
    (ofState initial query update q).queryAt f i =
      query ((fun s => update s (f (query s)))^[i] initial)

name: NLAlib.QueryAlgorithm.replay_history_ofState
statement:
theorem replay_history_ofState (initial : S) (query : S → Q) (update : S → R → S)
    (q : ℕ) (f : Q → R) (i : ℕ) :
    replay initial update ((ofState initial query update q).history f i) =
      (fun s => update s (f (query s)))^[i] initial

name: NLAlib.QueryAlgorithm.run_ofState
statement:
theorem run_ofState (initial : S) (query : S → Q) (update : S → R → S)
    (q : ℕ) (f : Q → R) :
    (ofState initial query update q).run f =
      (fun s => update s (f (query s)))^[q] initial

name: NLAlib.QueryAlgorithm.run_prependQuery
statement:
theorem run_prependQuery {q : ℕ} {β : Type*} (first : Q)
    (next : R → QueryAlgorithm Q R q β) (f : Q → R) :
    (prependQuery first next).run f = (next (f first)).run f

name: NLAlib.QueryAlgorithm.run_withOutput
statement:
theorem run_withOutput {q : ℕ} {α β : Type*} (alg : QueryAlgorithm Q R q α)
    (output : (Fin q → R) → β) (f : Q → R) :
    (alg.withOutput output).run f = output (alg.transcript f)

name: NLAlib.MatvecAlg.cost_ofQueryAlgorithm
statement:
@[simp] theorem cost_ofQueryAlgorithm {𝕜 n β : Type*} {q : ℕ}

name: NLAlib.QueryProgram.run_map

name: NLAlib.hermitianPartChebyshevCost_eq

theorem normalMixedMomentProgram_queryCount (M : ℕ) :

name: NLAlib.normalMixedProgramScalarWork_le
statement:
theorem normalMixedProgramScalarWork_le (b : n → ℂ) (M : ℕ)
    (oracle : Bool × (n → ℂ) → n → ℂ) :
    normalMixedProgramScalarWork b M oracle ≤ 13*Fintype.card n*(M+1)^2

name: NLAlib.run_hermitianPartChebyshevProgram
statement:
theorem run_hermitianPartChebyshevProgram (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (imaginary : Bool)
    (b : n → ℂ) (M j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ M) :
    (hermitianPartChebyshevProgram imaginary b M).run (matrixAdjointOracle A) j =
      (aeval (if imaginary then (imaginaryPart A : Matrix n n ℂ) else (realPart A : Matrix n n ℂ))
        (Chebyshev.T ℂ (j:ℤ))) *ᵥ b

name: NLAlib.run_hermitianPartChebyshevProgram_succ_eq_scalar
statement:
theorem run_hermitianPartChebyshevProgram_succ_eq_scalar
    (oracle : Bool × (n → ℂ) → n → ℂ) (imaginary : Bool) (b : n → ℂ) (k : ℕ) (r : n) :
    let V := (hermitianPartChebyshevProgram imaginary b k).run oracle
    let response := (hermitianPartProductProgram imaginary (V k)).run oracle
    ((hermitianPartChebyshevProgram imaginary b (k+1)).run oracle) (k+1) r =
      (chebyshevStepScalarProgram k (response r) (V (k-1) r)).run

name: NLAlib.run_hermitianPartChebyshevVectorProgram
statement:
theorem run_hermitianPartChebyshevVectorProgram (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (imaginary : Bool)
    (b : n → ℂ) (M : ℕ) :
    (hermitianPartChebyshevVectorProgram imaginary b M).run (matrixAdjointOracle A) =
      normalizedChebyshevVectorMatrix
        (if imaginary then (imaginaryPart A : Matrix n n ℂ) else (realPart A : Matrix n n ℂ)) b M

name: NLAlib.run_hermitianPartChebyshevVectorProgram_eq_scalar
statement:
theorem run_hermitianPartChebyshevVectorProgram_eq_scalar
    (oracle : Bool × (n → ℂ) → n → ℂ) (imaginary : Bool) (b : n → ℂ)
    (M : ℕ) (r : n) (j : Fin (M+1)) :
    ((hermitianPartChebyshevVectorProgram imaginary b M).run oracle) r j =
      (chebyshevNormalizeScalarProgram j
        (((hermitianPartChebyshevProgram imaginary b M).run oracle) j r)).run

name: NLAlib.run_hermitianPartProductProgram
statement:
theorem run_hermitianPartProductProgram (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (imaginary : Bool) (x : n → ℂ) :
    (hermitianPartProductProgram imaginary x).run (matrixAdjointOracle A) =
      (if imaginary then (imaginaryPart A : Matrix n n ℂ) else (realPart A : Matrix n n ℂ)) *ᵥ x

name: NLAlib.run_hermitianPartProductProgram_eq_scalar
statement:
theorem run_hermitianPartProductProgram_eq_scalar
    (oracle : Bool × (n → ℂ) → n → ℂ) (imaginary : Bool) (x : n → ℂ) (r : n) :
    ((hermitianPartProductProgram imaginary x).run oracle) r =
      (hermitianPartScalarProgram imaginary (oracle (false,x) r) (oracle (true,x) r)).run

name: NLAlib.run_normalMixedMomentProgram
statement:
theorem run_normalMixedMomentProgram (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (b : n → ℂ) (M : ℕ) :
    (normalMixedMomentProgram b M).run (matrixAdjointOracle A) =
      (normalizedChebyshevVectorMatrix (realPart A : Matrix n n ℂ) b M)ᴴ *
        normalizedChebyshevVectorMatrix (imaginaryPart A : Matrix n n ℂ) b M

name: NLAlib.run_normalMixedMomentProgram_eq_scalar
statement:
theorem run_normalMixedMomentProgram_eq_scalar
    (oracle : Bool × (n → ℂ) → n → ℂ) (b : n → ℂ) (M : ℕ) (j k : Fin (M+1)) :
    let XY := (normalMixedVectorProgram b M).run oracle
    ((normalMixedMomentProgram b M).run oracle) j k =
      (crossGramScalarProgram XY.1 XY.2 j k).run

name: NLAlib.run_normalMixedVectorProgram
statement:
theorem run_normalMixedVectorProgram (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (b : n → ℂ) (M : ℕ) :
    (normalMixedVectorProgram b M).run (matrixAdjointOracle A) =
      (normalizedChebyshevVectorMatrix (realPart A : Matrix n n ℂ) b M,
        normalizedChebyshevVectorMatrix (imaginaryPart A : Matrix n n ℂ) b M)

name: NLAlib.integral_normalCoordinateSpectralLaw_star_poly_mul_poly
statement:
theorem integral_normalCoordinateSpectralLaw_star_poly_mul_poly
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A*Aᴴ=Aᴴ*A) (b : n → ℂ) (p q : Polynomial ℂ) :
    (∫ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), star (p.eval (x 0 : ℂ))*q.eval (x 1 : ℂ)
      ∂normalCoordinateSpectralLaw hA b) =
      star ((Polynomial.aeval (realPart A : Matrix n n ℂ) p)*ᵥb) ⬝ᵥ
        ((Polynomial.aeval (imaginaryPart A : Matrix n n ℂ) q)*ᵥb)

name: NLAlib.normalMixedScalarWork_le
statement:
theorem normalMixedScalarWork_le (M : ℕ)
    (matrixResponse adjointResponse previous : Bool → Fin M → n → ℂ)
    (X Y : Matrix n (Fin (M+1)) ℂ) :
    normalMixedScalarWork M matrixResponse adjointResponse previous X Y ≤
      13*Fintype.card n*(M+1)^2

name: NLAlib.run_normalMixedMomentProgram_eq_coordinate_integral
statement:
theorem run_normalMixedMomentProgram_eq_coordinate_integral
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A*Aᴴ=Aᴴ*A) (b : n → ℂ) (M : ℕ)
    (j k : Fin (M+1)) :
    ((normalMixedMomentProgram b M).run (matrixAdjointOracle A)) j k =
      ∫ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        ((normalizedChebyshev j (x 0) * normalizedChebyshev k (x 1) : ℝ) : ℂ)
        ∂normalCoordinateSpectralLaw hA b

name: Polynomial.degree_linearPoleRemainder_lt
statement:
theorem degree_linearPoleRemainder_lt (v : ι → 𝕜) (s : ι → ℕ)
    (c : (i : ι) → Fin (s i) → 𝕜) :
    (linearPoleRemainder v s c).degree < (∑ i, s i : ℕ)

name: Polynomial.degree_mul_linearPoleProduct_add_linearPoleRemainder_lt_iff
statement:
theorem degree_mul_linearPoleProduct_add_linearPoleRemainder_lt_iff
    (v : ι → 𝕜) (s : ι → ℕ) {d : ℕ} (hmd : (∑ i, s i) ≤ d)
    (q : 𝕜[X]) (c : (i : ι) → Fin (s i) → 𝕜) :
    (q * linearPoleProduct v s + linearPoleRemainder v s c).degree < d ↔
      q.degree < (d - ∑ i, s i : ℕ)

name: Polynomial.existsUnique_eq_mul_linearPoleProduct_add_linearPoleRemainder
statement:
theorem existsUnique_eq_mul_linearPoleProduct_add_linearPoleRemainder
    (v : ι → 𝕜) (hv : Function.Injective v) (s : ι → ℕ) (p : 𝕜[X]) :
    ∃! qc : 𝕜[X] × ((i : ι) → Fin (s i) → 𝕜),
      p = qc.1 * linearPoleProduct v s + linearPoleRemainder v s qc.2

name: Polynomial.monic_linearPoleProduct
statement:
theorem monic_linearPoleProduct (v : ι → 𝕜) (s : ι → ℕ) :

name: NLAlib.sum_sum_ite_ne_eq_sub_diag
statement:
theorem sum_sum_ite_ne_eq_sub_diag {ι R : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    [AddCommGroup R] (f : ι → ι → R) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j, if i = j then 0 else f i j) =
      (∑ i, ∑ j, f i j) - ∑ i, f i i

name: Finset.sum_range_mul_blocks
statement:
theorem sum_range_mul_blocks {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M]
    (f : ℕ → M) (n m : ℕ) :
    ∑ k ∈ range (n * m), f k = ∑ i ∈ range n, ∑ j ∈ range m, f (i * m + j)

name: Finset.sum_grid_boundary_eq
statement:
theorem sum_grid_boundary_eq {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G]
    (bottom top left right : ℕ → ℕ → G) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (hc : ∀ i < n, ∀ j < n, bottom i j + right i j = top i j + left i j)
    (hh : ∀ i < n, ∀ j, j + 1 < n → bottom i (j + 1) = top i j)
    (hv : ∀ i, i + 1 < n → ∀ j < n, left (i + 1) j = right i j) :
    (∑ j ∈ range n, right (n - 1) j) - (∑ j ∈ range n, left 0 j) =
      (∑ i ∈ range n, top i (n - 1)) - (∑ i ∈ range n, bottom i 0)

name: Finset.sum_range_sub_of_adjacent
statement:
theorem sum_range_sub_of_adjacent {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G]
    (f g : ℕ → G) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (h : ∀ i, i + 1 < n → f (i + 1) = g i) :
    ∑ i ∈ range n, (f i - g i) = f 0 - g (n - 1)

name: NLAlib.counts_of_mem_subInsertionWords
NLAlib.insertionWord_sub_one_eq_sum
statement:
theorem insertionWord_sub_one_eq_sum (A H : R) (w : List Bool) :
    insertionWord A (H - 1) w =

name: NLAlib.insertionWords_eq_nil_of_lt

theorem insertionWords_eq_nil_of_lt {n j : ℕ} (hnj : n < j) :

statement:
theorem length_and_count_of_mem_insertionWords {n j : ℕ} {w : List Bool}

name: NLAlib.length_insertionWords
statement: theorem length_insertionWords (n j : ℕ) : (insertionWords n j).length = n.choose j

name: NLAlib.length_subInsertionWords

name: NLAlib.sum_insertionWords_succ_succ
statement:
theorem sum_insertionWords_succ_succ (A X : R) (n j : ℕ) :
    ((insertionWords (n + 1) (j + 1)).map (insertionWord A X)).sum =
      A * ((insertionWords n (j + 1)).map (insertionWord A X)).sum +
        X * ((insertionWords n j).map (insertionWord A X)).sum

name: NLAlib.sum_insertionWords_zero
statement:
theorem sum_insertionWords_zero (A X : R) (n : ℕ) :

      ((insertionWords n j).map (insertionWord A X)).sum) = (A + X) ^ n

name: NLAlib.degree_sub_lt_of_monic_natDegree_eq
NLAlib.degree_sub_lt_of_monic_nextCoeff_eq
statement:
theorem degree_sub_lt_of_monic_nextCoeff_eq {p q : ℝ[X]} {n : ℕ}
    (hp : p.Monic) (hq : q.Monic) (hpn : p.natDegree = n + 1)
    (hqn : q.natDegree = n + 1) (hc : p.nextCoeff = q.nextCoeff) :

name: NLAlib.polynomial_eq_base_sub_residue_sum
statement:
theorem polynomial_eq_base_sub_residue_sum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (d : ι → ℝ) (hd : Function.Injective d) (q base : ℝ[X])
    (hdeg : (q - base).degree < Fintype.card ι)
    (hbase : ∀ j, base.eval (d j) = 0) :
    q = base - ∑ j, C (-q.eval (d j) /
      (∏ l ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, (d j - d l))) *
        (∏ l ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, (X - C (d l)))

name: NLAlib.neg_prod_sub_div_prod_erase_nonneg_of_bordered_interlacing
statement:
theorem neg_prod_sub_div_prod_erase_nonneg_of_bordered_interlacing
    {n : ℕ} (d : Fin n → ℝ) (b : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (hd : StrictMono d) (hb : Monotone b)
    (h : ∀ i, b i.castSucc ≤ d i ∧ d i ≤ b i.succ) (j : Fin n) :
    0 ≤ -(∏ i, (d j - b i)) / (∏ l ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).erase j, (d j - d l))

name: NLAlib.neg_prod_sub_div_prod_erase_nonneg_of_rank_one_interlacing
statement:
theorem neg_prod_sub_div_prod_erase_nonneg_of_rank_one_interlacing
    {n : ℕ} (d b : Fin n → ℝ) (hd : StrictMono d) (hb : Monotone b)
    (hlo : ∀ i, d i ≤ b i)
    (hhi : ∀ i j : Fin n, i.val + 1 = j.val → b i ≤ d j) (j : Fin n) :
    0 ≤ -(∏ i, (d j - b i)) / (∏ l ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).erase j, (d j - d l))

name: NLAlib.sum_alternating_affine_two_mul
statement:
theorem sum_alternating_affine_two_mul {R : Type*} [Field R] (N : ℕ) (α β : R) :
    (∑ j ∈ range (2 * N), (-1 : R) ^ j * (α - ((j : R) + 1 / 2) * β)) = (N : R) * β

name: NLAlib.lagrange_basis_eq_weight_mul_prod
statement:
theorem lagrange_basis_eq_weight_mul_prod {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    {R : Type*} [Field R] (s : Finset ι) (v : ι → R) (i : ι) :
    Lagrange.basis s v i = C (Lagrange.nodalWeight s v i) * ∏ j ∈ s.erase i, (X - C (v j))

name: NLAlib.wronskian_C_mul_C_mul
statement:
theorem wronskian_C_mul_C_mul {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (a b : R) (p q : R[X]) :
    Polynomial.wronskian (C a * p) (C b * q) = C (a * b) * Polynomial.wronskian p q

name: NLAlib.wronskian_lagrange_basis
statement:
theorem wronskian_lagrange_basis {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    {R : Type*} [Field R] (s : Finset ι) (v : ι → R) {i j : ι}
    (hi : i ∈ s) (hj : j ∈ s) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    Polynomial.wronskian (Lagrange.basis s v i) (Lagrange.basis s v j) =
      C (Lagrange.nodalWeight s v i * Lagrange.nodalWeight s v j * (v i - v j)) *
        (∏ k ∈ (s.erase i).erase j, (X - C (v k))) ^ 2

name: NLAlib.wronskian_lagrange_partition_expansion
statement:
theorem wronskian_lagrange_partition_expansion {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    {R : Type*} [Field R] (s u v : Finset ι) (t : ι → R) (a b : ι → R)
    (hu : u ⊆ s) (hv : v ⊆ s) (hdis : Disjoint u v) :
    Polynomial.wronskian (∑ i ∈ u, C (a i) * Lagrange.basis s t i)
        (∑ j ∈ v, C (b j) * Lagrange.basis s t j) =
      ∑ i ∈ u, ∑ j ∈ v,
        C (a i * b j * Lagrange.nodalWeight s t i * Lagrange.nodalWeight s t j * (t i - t j)) *
          (∏ k ∈ (s.erase i).erase j, (X - C (t k))) ^ 2

name: CommRing.cayley_value_mul_inverse
statement:
theorem cayley_value_mul_inverse (t d e : R)
    (hd : (1-t)*d=1) (he : (1+t)*e=1) : (d*(1+t))*(e*(1-t))=1

name: CommRing.half_mul_cayley_add_inverse
statement:
theorem half_mul_cayley_add_inverse (t d e c : R)
    (hd : (1-t)*d=1) (he : (1+t)*e=1) (hc : c*2=1) :
    c*(d*(1+t)+e*(1-t)) = (d*e)*(1+t^2)

name: CommRing.one_sub_cayley_mul
statement:
theorem one_sub_cayley_mul (x e : R) (he : (x+1)*e=1) :
    (1-(x-1)*e)*x = 1+(x-1)*e

name: CommRing.one_sub_sq_mul_inverse_product
statement:
theorem one_sub_sq_mul_inverse_product (t d e : R)
    (hd : (1-t)*d=1) (he : (1+t)*e=1) : (1-t^2)*(d*e)=1

name: NLAlib.sum_sum_erase_comm
statement:
theorem sum_sum_erase_comm {α M : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [AddCommMonoid M]
    (s : Finset α) (f : α → α → M) :
    (∑ a ∈ s, ∑ c ∈ s.erase a, f a c) = ∑ c ∈ s, ∑ a ∈ s.erase c, f a c

name: NLAlib.neg_one_pow_mul_abs_nodalWeight
statement:
theorem neg_one_pow_mul_abs_nodalWeight {n : ℕ} {v : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ}
    (hv : StrictMono v) (r : Fin (n + 1)) (i : ℕ) :
    (-1 : ℝ) ^ (r.val + i) * |Lagrange.nodalWeight univ v r| =
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n + i) * Lagrange.nodalWeight univ v r

name: NLAlib.nodalWeight_eq_prod_ite
statement:
theorem nodalWeight_eq_prod_ite {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (v : ι → ℝ) (i : ι) :
    Lagrange.nodalWeight univ v i = ∏ j, if j = i then 1 else (v i - v j)⁻¹

name: NLAlib.signed_nodalWeight_pos
statement:
theorem signed_nodalWeight_pos {n : ℕ} {v : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ} (hv : StrictMono v)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) : 0 < (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - i.val) * Lagrange.nodalWeight univ v i

name: NLAlib.sum_eval_mul_nodalWeight_eq_zero
NLAlib.eval_nodal_gap_eq_sign_mul_abs
statement:
theorem eval_nodal_gap_eq_sign_mul_abs {n : ℕ} {v : Fin (n + 2) → ℝ}
    (hv : StrictMono v) (i : Fin (n + 1)) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Ioo (v i.castSucc) (v i.succ)) :
    (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x = (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * (-1 : ℝ) ^ i.val *

    {q : ℕ} {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} {v : Fin (q + 2) → ℝ}
    (hv : Monotone v) (hspan : v 0 < v (Fin.last _))
    (hva : ∀ i, v i ∈ Icc a b)
    (hrep : ∀ i : Fin (q + 1), v i.castSucc = v i.succ → v i.castSucc ∈ Ioo a b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc (v 0) (v (Fin.last _))))
    (hf' : ∀ k < q, ContinuousOn (iteratedDeriv (k + 1) f) (Ioo a b))
    (hz : ∀ i j, i ≤ j → v i = v j → iteratedDeriv (j.val - i.val) f (v i) = 0) :

    (hrep : ∀ x ∈ m, 1 < m.count x → x ∈ Ioo a b)

name: ContDiff.fderiv_sub_sub_smul_iteratedFDeriv_two_eq_smul_sq_integral_three
statement:
theorem ContDiff.fderiv_sub_sub_smul_iteratedFDeriv_two_eq_smul_sq_integral_three
    {Φ : E → F} (hΦ : ContDiff ℝ 3 Φ) (x D V : E) (a : ℝ) :
    (fderiv ℝ Φ (x + a • D) - fderiv ℝ Φ x) D -
        a • iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 Φ (x - a • V) ![D, D] =
      a ^ 2 • ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..1, ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..1,
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ 3 Φ
          (x - a • V + v • (a • (V + u • D))) ![V + u • D, D, D]

name: ContDiff.sub_eq_integral_fderiv_segment
ContDiff.sub_sub_smul_fderiv_eq_smul_integral_iteratedFDeriv_two
statement:

    f (x + a • h) - f x - a • fderiv ℝ f z h =
      a • ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..1, ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..1,
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f (z + v • (x + u • (a • h) - z))
          ![x + u • (a • h) - z, h]

theorem neg_normalized_exp_rectangleBoundaryIntegral_re_ge
    {h : ℂ → ℂ} {a b ε C : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hε' : ε ≤ 1)
    (hint : IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => exp (x + ε * I) * h (x + ε * I))
      volume a b)
    (hconj : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, h (x + (-ε) * I) = conj (h (x + ε * I)))
    (him : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, 0 ≤ (h (x + ε * I)).im)
    (hupper : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, ‖h (x + ε * I)‖ ≤ C)
    (hleft : ∀ y ∈ Icc (-ε) ε, ‖h (a + y * I)‖ ≤ C)
    (hright : ∀ y ∈ Icc (-ε) ε, ‖h (b + y * I)‖ ≤ C) :
    -((b - a + 2) * Real.exp b * C / Real.pi) * ε ≤
      (-((2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ *
        rectangleBoundaryIntegral (fun z => exp z * h z) a b (-ε) ε)).re

statement:

    {h : ℂ → ℂ} {a b C δ : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hh : DifferentiableOn ℂ h {z | z.im ≠ 0})
    (hleft : ContinuousOn (fun y : ℝ => h (a + y * I)) (Icc (-δ) δ))
    (hright : ContinuousOn (fun y : ℝ => h (b + y * I)) (Icc (-δ) δ))
    (hconj : ∀ z : ℂ, z.im ≠ 0 → h (conj z) = conj (h z))
    (him : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → 0 ≤ (h z).im)
    (hbound : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, ∀ y ∈ Icc (-δ) δ, ‖h (x + y * I)‖ ≤ C) :
    0 ≤ (-((2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ *
      rectangleBoundaryIntegral (fun z => exp z * h z) a b (-δ) δ)).re

name: Complex.neg_normalized_rectangleBoundaryIntegral_re_eq
statement:
theorem neg_normalized_rectangleBoundaryIntegral_re_eq
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} {a b ε : ℝ}
    (hf : IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => f (x + ε * I)) volume a b)
    (hconj : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, f (x + (-ε) * I) = conj (f (x + ε * I)))
    (hab : a ≤ b) :
    (-((2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ * rectangleBoundaryIntegral f a b (-ε) ε)).re =
      (∫ x in a..b, (f (x + ε * I)).im) / Real.pi -
        ((∫ y in -ε..ε, f (b + y * I)).re -
          (∫ y in -ε..ε, f (a + y * I)).re) / (2 * Real.pi)

    (hconj : ∀ ε ∈ Ioo 0 δ, ∀ x ∈ Icc a b,

    (him : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → 0 ≤ (h z).im)
    (hbound : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, ∀ y ∈ Icc (-δ) δ, ‖h (x + y * I)‖ ≤ C)
    (hw : ∀ ε ∈ Ioo 0 δ,

statement:
theorem primitivePathIntegral_boundary_eq_zero_of_grid
    {a b c d : ℂ} {g : ℂ → ℂ}
    (L : Path a b) (R : Path c d) (B : Path a c) (T : Path b d)
    (hL : Nonempty (PrimitivePathSubdivision g L.extend))
    (hR : Nonempty (PrimitivePathSubdivision g R.extend))
    (hB : Nonempty (PrimitivePathSubdivision g B.extend))
    (hT : Nonempty (PrimitivePathSubdivision g T.extend))
    {ψ : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ} (hψ : Continuous ψ) (D : PrimitiveHomotopyGrid g ψ)
    (hleft : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, L.extend t = ψ (0, t))
    (hright : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, R.extend t = ψ (1, t))
    (hbottom : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, B.extend t = ψ (t, 0))
    (htop : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, T.extend t = ψ (t, 1)) :
    primitivePathIntegral g R hR - primitivePathIntegral g L hL -
      primitivePathIntegral g T hT + primitivePathIntegral g B hB = 0

    {Ω : Set ℂ} {f : ℂ → ℂ} {t : ℂ}
    (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f Ω) (ht : t ∈ Ω)

statement:
theorem curveIntegral_inv_sub_quadrilateral_eq_zero_of_re_pos
    {v₀ v₁ v₂ v₃ τ r : ℂ} (hr : r ≠ 0)
    (h₀ : 0 < (r * (v₀ - τ)).re) (h₁ : 0 < (r * (v₁ - τ)).re)
    (h₂ : 0 < (r * (v₂ - τ)).re) (h₃ : 0 < (r * (v₃ - τ)).re) :
    curveIntegral (fun z => (z - τ)⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) (Path.segment v₀ v₁) +
      curveIntegral (fun z => (z - τ)⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) (Path.segment v₁ v₂) -
      curveIntegral (fun z => (z - τ)⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) (Path.segment v₃ v₂) -
      curveIntegral (fun z => (z - τ)⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) (Path.segment v₀ v₃) = 0

name: Complex.curveIntegral_inv_sub_rectangle_eq_two_pi_I
statement:
theorem curveIntegral_inv_sub_rectangle_eq_two_pi_I
    {a b c d : ℝ} {τ : ℂ}
    (ha : a < τ.re) (hb : τ.re < b) (hc : c < τ.im) (hd : τ.im < d) :
    curveIntegral (fun z => (z - τ)⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ)
        (Path.segment ((a : ℂ) + c * Complex.I) ((b : ℂ) + c * Complex.I)) +
      curveIntegral (fun z => (z - τ)⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ)
        (Path.segment ((b : ℂ) + c * Complex.I) ((b : ℂ) + d * Complex.I)) -
      curveIntegral (fun z => (z - τ)⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ)
        (Path.segment ((a : ℂ) + d * Complex.I) ((b : ℂ) + d * Complex.I)) -
      curveIntegral (fun z => (z - τ)⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ)
        (Path.segment ((a : ℂ) + c * Complex.I) ((a : ℂ) + d * Complex.I)) =
      (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I : ℂ)

name: Complex.curveIntegral_inv_sub_rectangle_eq_zero_of_outside
statement:
theorem curveIntegral_inv_sub_rectangle_eq_zero_of_outside
    {a b c d : ℝ} {τ : ℂ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d)
    (hout : τ.re < a ∨ b < τ.re ∨ τ.im < c ∨ d < τ.im) :
    curveIntegral (fun z => (z - τ)⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ)
        (Path.segment ((a : ℂ) + c * Complex.I) ((b : ℂ) + c * Complex.I)) +
      curveIntegral (fun z => (z - τ)⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ)
        (Path.segment ((b : ℂ) + c * Complex.I) ((b : ℂ) + d * Complex.I)) -
      curveIntegral (fun z => (z - τ)⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ)
        (Path.segment ((a : ℂ) + d * Complex.I) ((b : ℂ) + d * Complex.I)) -
      curveIntegral (fun z => (z - τ)⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ)
        (Path.segment ((a : ℂ) + c * Complex.I) ((a : ℂ) + d * Complex.I)) = 0

    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ}
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {c d : ℂ} (γ : Path c d)
    (hγ : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 γ.extend (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1))
    (hoff : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, γ.extend t ≠ (x : ℂ))
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.range γ)) :
    CurveIntegrable
      (fun z => (f z * (∫ x : ℝ, (z - (x : ℂ))⁻¹ ∂μ)) •
        ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) γ ∧
    (∫ x : ℝ, curveIntegral
      (fun z => (f z / (z - (x : ℂ))) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) γ ∂μ) =
      curveIntegral
        (fun z => (f z * (∫ x : ℝ, (z - (x : ℂ))⁻¹ ∂μ)) •

name: Fin.partialSum_sub
Complex.norm_sub_lt_two_mul_of_mem_coordinate_rectangle
statement:
theorem norm_sub_lt_two_mul_of_mem_coordinate_rectangle
    {a b c z : ℂ} {r : ℝ} (ha : ‖a - z‖ < r) (hb : ‖b - z‖ < r)

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.horizontal_apply
statement:
theorem horizontal_apply (x : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin m) (j : Fin (n + 1)) (t : I) :
    Grid.horizontal (vertex x y) i j t =
      (lineMap (x i.castSucc) (x i.succ) (t : ℝ) : ℝ) + y j * Complex.I

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.horizontal_mem_rectangle_of_walkCoefficient_ne_zero
statement:
theorem horizontal_mem_rectangle_of_walkCoefficient_ne_zero
    (x : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hx : Monotone x)
    (p q : Fin (m + 1) × Fin (n + 1)) (i : Fin m) (j : Fin (n + 1))
    (hc : Grid.walkHorizontalCoefficients p q i j ≠ 0) (t : I) :
    (Grid.horizontal (vertex x y) i j t).re ∈ uIcc (x p.1) (x q.1) ∧
      (Grid.horizontal (vertex x y) i j t).im ∈ uIcc (y p.2) (y q.2)

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.vertical_apply
statement:
theorem vertical_apply (x : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (m + 1)) (j : Fin n) (t : I) :
    Grid.vertical (vertex x y) i j t =
      (x i : ℂ) + (lineMap (y j.castSucc) (y j.succ) (t : ℝ) : ℝ) * Complex.I

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.vertical_mem_rectangle_of_walkCoefficient_ne_zero
statement:
theorem vertical_mem_rectangle_of_walkCoefficient_ne_zero
    (x : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hy : Monotone y)
    (p q : Fin (m + 1) × Fin (n + 1)) (i : Fin (m + 1)) (j : Fin n)
    (hc : Grid.walkVerticalCoefficients p q i j ≠ 0) (t : I) :
    (Grid.vertical (vertex x y) i j t).re ∈ uIcc (x p.1) (x q.1) ∧
      (Grid.vertical (vertex x y) i j t).im ∈ uIcc (y p.2) (y q.2)

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.walkChain_mem_rectangle
statement:
theorem walkChain_mem_rectangle
    (x : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hx : Monotone x) (hy : Monotone y)
    (p q : Fin (m + 1) × Fin (n + 1)) :
    ∀ γ ∈ (Grid.walkChain (vertex x y) p q).support, ∀ t,
      (γ t).re ∈ uIcc (x p.1) (x q.1) ∧ (γ t).im ∈ uIcc (y p.2) (y q.2)

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.walkChain_norm_sub_lt
statement:
theorem walkChain_norm_sub_lt
    {m n : ℕ} (x : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (hx : Monotone x) (hy : Monotone y) (p q : Fin (m + 1) × Fin (n + 1))
    {z : ℂ} {r : ℝ} (hp : ‖vertex x y p.1 p.2 - z‖ < r)
    (hq : ‖vertex x y q.1 q.2 - z‖ < r) :
    ∀ γ ∈ (Grid.walkChain (vertex x y) p q).support, ∀ t, ‖γ t - z‖ < 2 * r

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.boundaryOne_localComparisonChain
statement:
theorem boundaryOne_localComparisonChain
    (x : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (q : C → Fin (m + 1) × Fin (n + 1)) (γ : C(I, C)) :

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.exists_isNullHomologous_mapOne_eq_localComparisonChain
statement:
theorem exists_isNullHomologous_mapOne_eq_localComparisonChain
    (x : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hx : Monotone x) (hy : Monotone y)
    (q : C → Fin (m + 1) × Fin (n + 1)) {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hq : ∀ z : C, ‖vertex x y (q z).1 (q z).2 - z‖ < 2 * h)
    (γ : C(I, C)) (hγ : ∀ t, ‖(γ t : ℂ) - γ 0‖ < h) :
    ∃ Δ : OneChain (ball (γ 0 : ℂ) (8 * h)),
      mapOne (⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩ :
        C(ball (γ 0 : ℂ) (8 * h), ℂ)) Δ = localComparisonChain x y q γ ∧
          IsNullHomologous Δ

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.exists_isNullHomologous_mapOne_eq_localComparisonChain_thickening
statement:
theorem exists_isNullHomologous_mapOne_eq_localComparisonChain_thickening
    (x : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hx : Monotone x) (hy : Monotone y)
    (q : C → Fin (m + 1) × Fin (n + 1)) {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hq : ∀ z : C, ‖vertex x y (q z).1 (q z).2 - z‖ < 2 * h)
    (γ : C(I, C)) (hγ : ∀ t, ‖(γ t : ℂ) - γ 0‖ < h) :
    ∃ Δ : OneChain (thickening (8 * h) C),
      mapOne (⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩ :
        C(thickening (8 * h) C, ℂ)) Δ = localComparisonChain x y q γ ∧
          IsNullHomologous Δ

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.localComparisonChain_mapsTo_ball
statement:
theorem localComparisonChain_mapsTo_ball
    (x : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hx : Monotone x) (hy : Monotone y)
    (q : C → Fin (m + 1) × Fin (n + 1)) {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hq : ∀ z : C, ‖vertex x y (q z).1 (q z).2 - z‖ < 2 * h)
    (γ : C(I, C)) (hγ : ∀ t, ‖(γ t : ℂ) - γ 0‖ < h) :
    ∀ δ ∈ (localComparisonChain x y q γ).support, ∀ t,
      δ t ∈ ball (γ 0 : ℂ) (8 * h)

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.edgeChainMap_subdivisionWalkCoefficients
statement:
theorem edgeChainMap_subdivisionWalkCoefficients
    (x : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (q : C → Fin (m + 1) × Fin (n + 1)) (γ : C(I, C)) (k : ℕ) :
    Grid.edgeChainMap (vertex x y) (subdivisionWalkCoefficients q γ k) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, Grid.walkChain (vertex x y)
        (q (γ (uniformNode k i))) (q (γ (uniformNode k (i + 1))))

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.exists_isNullHomologous_mapOne_eq_edgeComparison
statement:
theorem exists_isNullHomologous_mapOne_eq_edgeComparison
    (x : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hx : Monotone x) (hy : Monotone y)
    (q : C → Fin (m + 1) × Fin (n + 1)) {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hq : ∀ z : C, ‖vertex x y (q z).1 (q z).2 - z‖ < 2 * h)
    (γ : C(I, C)) :
    ∃ c : Grid.Coefficients m n, ∃ Δ : OneChain (thickening (8 * h) C),
      mapOne (⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩ :
        C(thickening (8 * h) C, ℂ)) Δ =
          Finsupp.single ((⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩ : C(C, ℂ)).comp γ) 1 +
            Finsupp.single (quantizerConnector x y q (γ 1)) 1 -
            Grid.edgeChainMap (vertex x y) c -
            Finsupp.single (quantizerConnector x y q (γ 0)) 1 ∧
        IsNullHomologous Δ

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.sum_localComparisonChain_subedge
statement:
theorem sum_localComparisonChain_subedge
    (x : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (q : C → Fin (m + 1) × Fin (n + 1)) (γ : C(I, C)) {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k,
        localComparisonChain x y q (subedge γ (uniformNode k i) (uniformNode k (i + 1))) =
      mapOne (⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩ : C(C, ℂ))
          (subdivisionChain γ (uniformNode k) k) +
        Finsupp.single (quantizerConnector x y q (γ 1)) 1 -
        Grid.edgeChainMap (vertex x y) (subdivisionWalkCoefficients q γ k) -
        Finsupp.single (quantizerConnector x y q (γ 0)) 1

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.coe_floorIndex
statement:
theorem coe_floorIndex (N : ℕ) (u : ℝ) (hlo : -(N : ℝ) ≤ u) (hhi : u < N) :
    (floorIndex N u hlo hhi : ℝ) = (⌊u⌋ : ℝ) + N

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.coordinate_floorIndex_error
statement:
theorem coordinate_floorIndex_error (N : ℕ) {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (r : ℝ)
    (hlo : -(N : ℝ) ≤ r / h) (hhi : r / h < N) :
    coordinate N h (floorIndex N (r / h) hlo hhi) ≤ r ∧
      r - coordinate N h (floorIndex N (r / h) hlo hhi) < h

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.coordinate_succ_sub_castSucc
statement:
theorem coordinate_succ_sub_castSucc (N : ℕ) (h : ℝ) (i : Fin (2 * N)) :

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.exists_normalized_coordinate_box
statement:
theorem exists_normalized_coordinate_box {C : Set ℂ} (hC : IsCompact C)
    {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ z ∈ C,
      (-(N : ℝ) ≤ z.re / h ∧ z.re / h < N) ∧
        (-(N : ℝ) ≤ z.im / h ∧ z.im / h < N)

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.exists_quantizer
statement:
theorem exists_quantizer {C : Set ℂ} (hC : IsCompact C) {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∃ q : C → Fin (2 * N + 1) × Fin (2 * N + 1),
      ∀ z : C, ‖vertex (coordinate N h) (coordinate N h) (q z).1 (q z).2 - z‖ < 2 * h

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.strictMono_coordinate
statement:
theorem strictMono_coordinate (N : ℕ) {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) :

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.connectorChainMap_boundaryOne_single
statement:
theorem connectorChainMap_boundaryOne_single
    (x : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (q : C → Fin (m + 1) × Fin (n + 1)) (γ : C(I, C)) (k : ℤ) :
    connectorChainMap x y q (boundaryOne (Finsupp.single γ k)) =
      k • Finsupp.single (quantizerConnector x y q (γ 1)) 1 -
        k • Finsupp.single (quantizerConnector x y q (γ 0)) 1

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.exists_isNullHomologous_mapOne_eq_cycleComparison
statement:
theorem exists_isNullHomologous_mapOne_eq_cycleComparison
    (x : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (hx : StrictMono x) (hy : StrictMono y)
    (q : C → Fin (m + 1) × Fin (n + 1)) {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hq : ∀ z : C, ‖vertex x y (q z).1 (q z).2 - z‖ < 2 * h)
    (Γ : OneChain C) (hc : boundaryOne Γ = 0) :
    ∃ c : Grid.Coefficients m n, ∃ Δ : OneChain (thickening (8 * h) C),
      mapOne (⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩ :
        C(thickening (8 * h) C, ℂ)) Δ =
          mapOne (⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩ : C(C, ℂ)) Γ -

name: Cubical.RectangularGrid.exists_uniform_grid_cycle_approximation
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_grid_cycle_approximation (hC : IsCompact C) {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h)

            mapOne (⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩ : C(C, ℂ)) Γ -

statement:
theorem rectangularGrid_cell_mem_of_comparison
    {C Ω : Set ℂ} (Γ : OneChain C) (hc : boundaryOne Γ = 0)
    (hΓ : ∀ γ ∈ Γ.support, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (cubicalPath γ).extend I)

statement:
theorem cubicalWindingIntegral_pathChain_eq_one_of_curveIntegral_eq
    {Ω : Set ℂ} {k : ℕ} (p : Fin (k + 1) → Ω)
    (γ : (i : Fin k) → Path (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ))
    (hp : p (Fin.last k) = p 0)
    (hγ : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ((γ i).map continuous_subtype_val).extend I)
    {a b x₀ : ℝ} (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ Icc a b)
    (hoff : ∀ i r, ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, ((γ i) r : ℂ) ≠ (x : ℂ))
    (hpos : (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I : ℂ)⁻¹ *

theorem norm_le_exp_hirschman_boundary_majorants {r B H : ℝ}
    (hr : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) {g : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hg : DiffContOnCl ℂ g (HadamardThreeLines.verticalStrip 0 1))
    (hbound : ∀ z ∈ HadamardThreeLines.verticalClosedStrip 0 1, ‖g z‖ ≤ B)
    (h₀ h₁ : ℝ → ℝ) (hm₀ : Measurable h₀) (hm₁ : Measurable h₁)
    (hb₀ : ∀ t, |h₀ t| ≤ H) (hb₁ : ∀ t, |h₁ t| ≤ H)
    (hleft : ∀ t : ℝ, ‖g ((t : ℂ) * I)‖ ≤ Real.exp (h₀ t))
    (hright : ∀ t : ℝ, ‖g (1 + (t : ℂ) * I)‖ ≤ Real.exp (h₁ t)) :
    ‖g (r : ℂ)‖ ≤ Real.exp (
      (∫ t : ℝ, ((1 - r) * hirschmanDensity (1 - r) t) * h₀ t) +
      ∫ t : ℝ, (r * hirschmanDensity r t) * h₁ t)

name: NLAlib.exists_common_power_factors_of_power_factorizations
statement:
theorem exists_common_power_factors_of_power_factorizations
    {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    {θ : ℝ} (hθ : θ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (a : κ → ℝ) (u v : ι → κ → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ x, 0 ≤ a x) (hu : ∀ l x, 0 ≤ u l x) (hv : ∀ l x, 0 ≤ v l x)
    (hfactor : ∀ l x, a x = u l x ^ (1 - θ) * v l x ^ θ) :
    ∃ U V : κ → ℝ,
      (∀ x, 0 ≤ U x) ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ V x) ∧
      (∀ x, a x = U x ^ (1 - θ) * V x ^ θ) ∧
      (∀ x, U x ^ 2 = ∑ l, u l x ^ 2) ∧
      (∀ l x, V x ≤ v l x)

name: NLAlib.exists_common_power_factors_with_right_eq
statement:
theorem exists_common_power_factors_with_right_eq
    {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]

    (a : κ → ℝ) (u v : ι → κ → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ x, 0 ≤ a x) (hu : ∀ l x, 0 ≤ u l x) (hv : ∀ l x, 0 ≤ v l x)
    (hfactor : ∀ l x, a x = u l x ^ (1 - θ) * v l x ^ θ) :
    ∃ U V : κ → ℝ,
      (∀ x, 0 ≤ U x) ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ V x) ∧
      (∀ x, a x = U x ^ (1 - θ) * V x ^ θ) ∧
      (∀ x, U x ^ 2 = ∑ l, u l x ^ 2) ∧
      (∀ l x, V x ≤ v l x) ∧

    (hexp : 1 / p = (1 - θ) / 2 + θ / q)
    (a : ι → κ → ℝ) (s : ι → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ a i j) (hs : ∀ i, 0 ≤ s i)
    (hsum : ∀ i, ∑ j, a i j ^ 2 = s i ^ 2) :
    ∃ u v : ι → κ → ℝ,
      (∀ i j, 0 ≤ u i j) ∧ (∀ i j, 0 ≤ v i j) ∧
      (∀ i j, a i j = u i j ^ (1 - θ) * v i j ^ θ) ∧
      (∑ i, ∑ j, u i j ^ 2) = ∑ i, s i ^ p ∧
      (∑ i, (∑ j, v i j ^ 2) ^ (q / 2)) = ∑ i, s i ^ p

    ∃ u v : κ → ℝ,
      (∀ x, 0 ≤ u x) ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ v x) ∧
      (∀ x, a x = u x ^ (1 - θ) * v x ^ θ) ∧
      (∑ x, u x ^ 2) = ∑ x, a x ^ p ∧

name: NLAlib.exists_weighted_scalar_power_factors
statement:
theorem exists_weighted_scalar_power_factors
    {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] {p q θ c : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hq : 0 < q) (hθ : θ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hexp : 1 / p = (1 - θ) / 2 + θ / q)
    (a : κ → ℝ) (ha : ∀ x, 0 ≤ a x) :
    ∃ u v : κ → ℝ,
      (∀ x, 0 ≤ u x) ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ v x) ∧

      (∑ x, u x ^ 2) = c ^ (θ * p) * ∑ x, a x ^ p ∧

    (hstep : ∀ n p, 1 ≤ p → p ≤ q →

    (hstep : ∀ n p, 1 ≤ p → p ≤ q →
      M (n + 1) p ≤ M n p + finiteMomentUpdate ν R (M n) p) :

name: NLAlib.sum_rpow_le_rpow_sum
statement:
theorem sum_rpow_le_rpow_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ f i) {r : ℝ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, f i ^ r) ≤ (∑ i ∈ s, f i) ^ r

name: NLAlib.sum_rpow_root_le_card_rpow_mul
statement:
theorem sum_rpow_root_le_card_rpow_mul {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ f i) {p q : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hpq : p ≤ q) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, f i ^ p) ^ (1 / p) ≤
      (s.card : ℝ) ^ (1 / p - 1 / q) * (∑ i ∈ s, f i ^ q) ^ (1 / q)

name: NLAlib.sum_rpow_root_le_sum_rpow_root
statement:
theorem sum_rpow_root_le_sum_rpow_root {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ f i) {p q : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hpq : p ≤ q) :

name: NLAlib.sum_mul_mul_le_rpow_sum_mul_rpow
statement:
theorem sum_mul_mul_le_rpow_sum_mul_rpow {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (w f g : ι → ℝ) {p q : ℝ} (hpq : p.HolderConjugate q)
    (hw : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i) (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ f i)
    (hg : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ g i) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, w i * f i * g i) ≤
      (∑ i ∈ s, w i * f i ^ p) ^ (1 / p) *
        (∑ i ∈ s, w i * g i ^ q) ^ (1 / q)

name: Real.sum_mul_prod_pow_le_prod_pow
statement:
theorem sum_mul_prod_pow_le_prod_pow
    {Ω ι : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype ι]
    (ρ : Ω → ℝ) (hρ : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ ρ ω)
    (f : ι → Ω → ℝ) (hf : ∀ i ω, 0 ≤ f i ω)
    (e : ι → ℕ) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (he : ∑ i, e i = N)
    (C : ι → ℝ) (hC : ∀ i, 0 < C i)
    (hmoment : ∀ i, (∑ ω, ρ ω * f i ω ^ N) ≤ C i ^ N) :
    (∑ ω, ρ ω * ∏ i, f i ω ^ e i) ≤ ∏ i, C i ^ e i

name: Finset.sum_range_sum_range_eq_sum_displacements
statement:
theorem sum_range_sum_range_eq_sum_displacements {A : Type*} [AddCommMonoid A]
    (f : ℕ → ℕ → A) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ l ∈ range n, ∑ j ∈ range l, f j l) =
      ∑ d ∈ range n, ∑ j ∈ range (n - (d + 1)), f j (j + d + 1)

name: NLAlib.normSq_sum_real_mul_fourier_eq_autocorrelation
statement:
theorem normSq_sum_real_mul_fourier_eq_autocorrelation
    (v : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) :
    Complex.normSq (∑ j ∈ range n, (v j : ℂ) * fourier (j : ℤ) t) =
      (∑ j ∈ range n, v j ^ 2) +
        2 * ∑ d ∈ range n, (∑ j ∈ range (n - (d + 1)), v j * v (j + d + 1)) *
          (fourier ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) t).re

name: NLAlib.fourierCoeff_fourier_mul

    (hbound : ∀ i t, ‖F i t‖ ≤ b i) (hseries : ∀ t, HasSum (fun i => F i t) (f t))

name: NLAlib.norm_sum_comp_sq_le_of_projections
statement:

    (hEadj : E† = E) (hFadj : F† = F) (hGadj : G† = G)
    (_hEid : E ∘L E = E) (hFid : F ∘L F = F) (_hGid : G ∘L G = G)

    ∃ g : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ, (∀ n : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ n g) ∧
      (∀ x y, |g x - g y| ≤ L * Real.sqrt (∑ i, (x i - y i) ^ 2)) ∧
      ∀ x, |g x - f x| ≤ ε

    lobattoKernelSum n t =
      (∑ j ∈ range n, |lobattoKernel n (t + j * π / n)|) +
      ∑ j ∈ range n, |lobattoKernel n (t - (j + 1 : ℕ) * π / n)|

    (hα : α ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    lobattoKernelSum n (α * π / n) = sin (π * α) / (2 * n) *
      ∑ j ∈ range n, (Real.cot (((j : ℝ) + α) * π / (2 * n)) +
        Real.cot (((j : ℝ) + 1 - α) * π / (2 * n)))
